title: RoomEQ Input Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the roomeq room equalization optimizer

system.description: System topology and logical channel mapping (v2.1)

speakers.description: Map of channel names to speaker configurations

crossovers.description: Crossover configurations referenced by multi-driver speakers

recording_config.description: Recording configuration (device settings, signal parameters used during measurement capture)

SystemConfig.description: Explicit system configuration mapping logical roles to measurements

speakers.description: Map of Logical Role -> Measurement Key (e.g., "L": "left_meas")

SubwooferSystemConfig.description: Subwoofer configuration. Includes 'config' strategy, optional 'crossover' reference, and a map of Subwoofer Measurement Key -> Main Speaker Logical Role (flattened).

crossover.description: Reference to a crossover definition in the 'crossovers' map

additionalProperties.description: Logical main channel role to align with

SpeakerConfig.description: Speaker configuration (single, multi-driver group, multi-sub, or DBA)

MeasurementSource.description: Source of measurements (single file or multiple for averaging)

MeasurementRef.description: Reference to a measurement file or inline data

name.description: Optional display name for the measurement

oneOf.description: Inline measurement data (stored directly in JSON)

InlineMeasurement.description: Inline measurement data stored directly in the JSON configuration (no external CSV file needed)

wav_path.description: Optional path to associated WAV file

csv_path.description: Optional path to associated CSV file

SpeakerGroup.description: Multi-driver speaker group with crossover. IMPORTANT: For accurate crossover optimization, measurements should include phase data. The optimizer uses complex summation (vector sum) to model interference between drivers at crossover frequencies. Without phase data, the optimizer assumes 0° phase, which may result in suboptimal crossover frequencies and driver alignment.

measurements.description: Measurements for each driver (ordered from lowest to highest frequency). Include phase data for accurate crossover optimization.

crossover.description: Key referencing a crossover in the crossovers map

MultiSubGroup.description: Multiple subwoofers with gain/delay optimization. IMPORTANT: For accurate optimization, measurements MUST include phase data. The optimizer uses complex summation (H_total = H_sub1 + H_sub2 * e^(-jωτ)) to model constructive/destructive interference between subwoofers. Without phase data, the optimizer cannot properly find delay settings that maximize summation at the listening position.

subwoofers.description: Measurements for each subwoofer. MUST include phase data (e.g., export from REW with phase) for accurate delay optimization.

allpass_optimization.description: Enable per-subwoofer all-pass filter optimization (Dirac Bass Control inspired). When true, optimizes gain + delay + all-pass biquad per sub for improved phase alignment and mode cancellation. Uses DE global optimizer.

DBAConfig.description: Double Bass Array with front and rear arrays. IMPORTANT: For accurate DBA optimization, measurements MUST include phase data. The optimizer uses complex summation to model the interference between front and rear arrays. The rear array is automatically phase-inverted (180°) to create the pressure wave cancellation pattern characteristic of DBA systems.

front.description: Measurements for the front array. Include phase data for accurate optimization.

rear.description: Measurements for the rear array (will be phase-inverted by adding 180°). Include phase data for accurate optimization.

CardioidConfig.description: Gradient Cardioid subwoofer configuration (2 subs). Optimizes a pair of subwoofers (Front/Rear) to create a directional pattern by applying delay and inversion to the rear sub. Delay is calculated from physical separation.

separation_meters.description: Physical separation distance between acoustic centers (meters)

frequency.description: Fixed crossover frequency in Hz (for 2-way speakers)

frequencies.description: Fixed crossover frequencies in Hz (for 3-way and above, e.g., [500, 3000] for woofer/mid at 500Hz, mid/tweeter at 3000Hz)

frequency_range.description: Frequency range [min, max] in Hz for automatic optimization

oneOf.description: Predefined target or path to CSV file

mode.description: Optimization mode: 'iir' uses parametric EQ filters (biquads), 'fir' generates FIR impulse response files (WAV), 'mixed' combines both (IIR for high frequencies, FIR for low frequencies by default), 'mixed_phase' uses IIR for minimum-phase + short FIR for excess phase correction.

processing_mode.description: Processing mode for RoomEQ v2. 'low_latency' = IIR only (< 5ms), 'phase_linear' = FIR only, 'hybrid' = IIR bass + FIR mids/highs, 'mixed_phase' = IIR minimum-phase + short FIR for excess phase (~10ms latency, requires phase data).

fir.description: FIR configuration (when mode is 'fir' or 'mixed'). The generated FIR filter is saved as a WAV file and referenced in the output via a convolution plugin.

mixed_config.description: Mixed mode configuration for frequency-based crossover. When mode='mixed' and this is set, uses frequency-based crossover (FIR on one band, IIR on the other).

mixed_phase.description: Mixed-phase correction configuration. Used when processing_mode='mixed_phase'. Decomposes measurement into minimum-phase (IIR) and excess phase (short FIR).

num_filters.description: Number of PEQ filters per channel

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible results. When set, the optimizer will produce deterministic results.

refine.description: Enable hybrid two-stage optimization. Stage 1 (Global): Differential Evolution finds approximate solution. Stage 2 (Local): COBYLA fine-tunes the result for minimal residual error. Recommended for best results.

local_algo.description: Local optimizer algorithm for refinement stage (when refine=true)

psychoacoustic.description: Enable psychoacoustic variable smoothing before optimization. Applies 1/48 octave smoothing below 100 Hz (preserves audible room modes) and 1/6 octave smoothing above 1 kHz (ignores inaudible comb filtering). Recommended for room correction.

asymmetric_loss.description: Enable asymmetric loss weighting where peaks are penalized 2x more than dips. This is psychoacoustically correct: we can hear and fix peaks with EQ cuts, but nulls/dips cannot be fixed with EQ boosts (boosting into a null just wastes amplifier power). Recommended for room correction.

allow_delay.description: Allow inter-speaker delay optimization. When true, the optimizer generates delay plugins to align speakers in time (time alignment, phase alignment, group delay optimization). Default: false for IIR mode (low-latency), true for FIR and mixed modes. When omitted, the default is inferred from the mode.

target_tilt.description: Target curve tilt configuration for Harman-style room curves

excursion_protection.description: Excursion protection configuration for bookshelf speakers

schroeder_split.description: Schroeder frequency split for different Q constraints above/below transition frequency

phase_alignment.description: Phase alignment configuration for subwoofer integration

multi_measurement.description: Multi-measurement optimization configuration. Controls how multiple measurements per speaker are combined during optimization.

decomposed_correction.description: Decomposed correction configuration (Trinnov-inspired). Applies frequency-dependent correction weights based on acoustic decomposition.

phase.description: Phase response type: 'linear' produces symmetric FIR, 'minimum' produces minimum-phase FIR, 'kirkeby' applies magnitude limits

correct_excess_phase.description: Whether to correct excess phase (kirkeby mode only). When true, corrects both magnitude and excess phase (measured phase minus minimum phase derived from magnitude). When false (default), only corrects magnitude producing a linear-phase FIR. Excess phase correction requires clean phase measurements to be effective.

phase_smoothing.description: Phase smoothing width in octaves (default: 0.167 = 1/6 octave). Applied via group delay smoothing when excess phase correction is enabled. Smoothing reduces noise artifacts in phase measurements. Set to 0.0 to disable smoothing.

pre_ringing.description: Pre-ringing suppression configuration. When set, FIR filter pre-ringing is constrained to the specified threshold.

PreRingingSerdeConfig.description: Pre-ringing suppression configuration for FIR filters

threshold_db.description: Maximum pre-ringing level in dB relative to main tap

MixedModeConfig.description: Mixed mode configuration for frequency-based crossover. When mode='mixed' and this is set, the optimizer uses different filter types for different frequency bands separated by a crossover frequency.

crossover_freq.description: Crossover frequency dividing IIR and FIR bands (Hz)

fir_band.description: Which band uses FIR: 'low' or 'high'. FIR is typically better for low frequencies (bass room modes).

MixedPhaseSerdeConfig.description: Mixed-phase correction configuration. Decomposes measurement into minimum-phase component (corrected by IIR) and excess phase component (corrected by short FIR). Requires phase data in measurements. Low latency (~10ms).

max_fir_length_ms.description: Maximum FIR length in milliseconds for excess phase correction

min_spatial_depth.description: Minimum spatial correction depth for excess phase correction (0.0-1.0)

TargetTiltConfig.description: Target curve tilt configuration. Applies a frequency-dependent tilt to the target curve instead of flat. Harman-style tilt (-0.8 dB/octave) is psychoacoustically preferred for in-room listening.

slope_db_per_octave.description: Slope in dB per octave (negative = downward tilt towards high frequencies). Used when tilt_type is 'custom'.

reference_freq.description: Reference frequency where tilt equals 0 dB (Hz)

bass_shelf_db.description: Bass shelf boost in dB (applied below bass_shelf_freq)

ExcursionProtectionConfig.description: Excursion protection configuration. Detects the speaker's F3 rolloff point and generates a highpass filter to prevent dangerous over-boost of bass frequencies on bookshelf speakers.

manual_f3_hz.description: Manual F3 override in Hz (used if auto_detect_f3 is false)

margin_octaves.description: Safety margin in octaves below F3 for HPF placement. HPF is placed at F3 * 2^(-margin_octaves)

SchroederSplitConfig.description: Schroeder frequency split configuration. Different Q constraints below and above the Schroeder frequency. Below: high-Q narrow filters to address room modes. Above: low-Q broad filters for gentle tone control.

schroeder_freq.description: Schroeder frequency in Hz (typical: 200-500 Hz for domestic rooms)

room_dimensions.description: Room dimensions for automatic Schroeder frequency calculation (optional)

RoomDimensions.description: Room dimensions for Schroeder frequency calculation

LowFreqFilterConfig.description: Low frequency filter configuration for Schroeder split (below Schroeder frequency)

max_q.description: Maximum Q factor for low frequency filters (high-Q for mode correction)

allow_boost.description: Allow boost (true) or cuts only (false). Cuts-only is recommended for room modes.

HighFreqFilterConfig.description: High frequency filter configuration for Schroeder split (above Schroeder frequency)

max_q.description: Maximum Q factor for high frequency filters (low-Q for tone control)

shelving_only.description: Use shelving filters only (no parametric peaks)

PhaseAlignmentConfig.description: Phase alignment configuration for subwoofer integration. Optimizes delay and polarity to maximize energy sum in the crossover region between subwoofer and main speakers.

MultiSeatConfig.description: Multi-seat optimization configuration. Optimizes subwoofer delays and gains to minimize response variance across multiple listening positions.

primary_seat.description: Index of primary seat (0-based, used with primary_with_constraints strategy)

max_deviation_db.description: Maximum allowed deviation at non-primary seats (dB, used with primary_with_constraints)

BroadbandTargetMatchingConfig.description: Configuration for broadband target matching. Fits Low Shelf, High Shelf, and Gain filters to match the target curve across the full frequency range (20Hz-20kHz) before fine-grained optimization.

GroupDelayOptimizationConfig.description: Configuration for Group Delay Optimization (GD-Opt). Optimizes crossover group delay alignment.

target_ms.description: Target group delay at crossover (ms). 0.0 = perfect alignment.

VoiceOfGodConfig.description: Voice of God (Timbre Matching) configuration. Matches the tonal character of all speakers to a reference channel.

MultiMeasurementConfig.description: Configuration for multi-measurement optimization. When a speaker has multiple measurements (different listening positions), controls how they are combined during optimization.

weights.description: Weights for weighted_sum strategy (normalized internally). Equal weights if omitted.

variance_lambda.description: Lambda for variance_penalized strategy. Higher = more consistent across positions.

SpatialRobustnessSerdeConfig.description: Spatial robustness configuration. Only corrects features consistent across positions (Dirac-inspired). Uses a correction depth mask based on inter-position variance.

variance_threshold_db.description: Variance threshold (dB) below which full correction is allowed

mask_smoothing_octaves.description: Smoothing width in octaves for the correction depth mask

DecomposedCorrectionSerdeConfig.description: Decomposed correction configuration (Trinnov-inspired). When enabled, applies frequency-dependent correction weights: room modes (below Schroeder) get full correction, steady-state response (above Schroeder) gets gentle correction, position-dependent features get reduced correction.

schroeder_freq.description: Schroeder frequency (Hz). Below: modal, above: statistical.

min_mode_q.description: Minimum Q to qualify as a room mode

mode_correction_weight.description: Correction weight for detected room modes (0.0-1.0)

steady_state_weight.description: Correction weight for steady-state above Schroeder (0.0-1.0)

RecordingConfiguration.description: Recording configuration stored with measurements. Contains device settings and signal parameters used during measurement capture.

signal_type.description: Signal type used for measurements (e.g., 'Sweep', 'Pink Noise')

sweep_start_freq.description: Sweep start frequency in Hz (only applicable when signal_type is 'Sweep')

sweep_end_freq.description: Sweep end frequency in Hz (only applicable when signal_type is 'Sweep')
